title: Zoho Desk (live, techegysolutions) — subject of the email Zoho actually sent for an agent reply (thread originalContent.subject)
who: Zoho admin (QA RT20 ZS data, contact on example.com)
rows: 1 Plain subject #151
POST /tickets/{#151}/sendReply (ticket subject 'QA RT20 ZS ack test'), then GET /threads/{id}/originalContent
subject = 'Re:[## 151 ##] QA RT20 ZS ack test'  — Zoho adds ONE 'Re:' + its own [## n ##] tag
ok
2 Second reply #151
sendReply again on the same ticket
subject = 'Re:[## 151 ##] QA RT20 ZS ack test' — identical; nothing piles up (built from the ticket subject, not the last mail)
ok
3 Subject already 'Re: Re: … [#4745]' #152
ticket subject 'Re: Re: QA RT20 ZS ack test [#4745]' (foreign tag style), sendReply
subject = 'Re:[## 152 ##] Re: Re: QA RT20 ZS ack test [#4745]' — Zoho does not strip old 'Re:'; foreign [#4745] is not its tag so it adds [## 152 ##]
info
4 Subject already holds Zoho's own tag #153
ticket subject 'Re: Re: QA RT20 ZS own tag [##153##]', sendReply
subject = 'Re:Re: Re: QA RT20 ZS own tag [##153##]' — tag NOT added a second time; only 'Re:' prefixed
ok
5 Reply acknowledgement template
GET /api/v1/templates (both depts) 'Acknowledge contact on receiving a reply'
subject = '[##${Cases.Request Id}##] Your reply has been received' — fixed text; does not reuse the customer's reply subject, so no Re:/tag repetition is possible
ok
